title: v1_114 / Thank you
content: ## Thank you Contributions to our issue tracking: * [@gjsjohnmurray (John Murray)](https://github.com/gjsjohnmurray) * [@RedCMD (RedCMD)](https://github.com/RedCMD) * [@IllusionMH (Andrii Dieiev)](https://github.com/IllusionMH) * [@albertosantini (Alberto Santini)](https://github.com/albertosantini) Contributions to `vscode`: * [@a77ming](https://github.com/a77ming): Fix wrapped title spacing on the agent sessions welcome page [PR #304686](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/304686) * [@AshtonYoon (Ashton Yoon)](https://github.com/AshtonYoon): Fix janky scrolling in markdown preview with code blocks [PR #287050](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/287050) * [@buley (Tay)](https://github.com/buley): fix: destroy read streams to prevent file descriptor leaks [PR #303395](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/303395) * [@ConsoleTVs (Erik C. Forés)](https://github.com/ConsoleTVs): fix(mcp): resolve env vars in agent plugin MCP server definitions [PR #303156](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/303156) * [@jonathanrao99 (Jonathan Thota)](https://github.com/jonathanrao99): browser: prevent new tab from flashing in quick pick [PR #304297](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/304297) * [@ShehabSherif0 (Shehab Sherif)](https://github.com/ShehabSherif0) * Fix operator precedence in fuzzyScore2 test assertion [PR #304449](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/304449) * Fix copy-paste bug in performance view blocking startup count [PR #304452](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/304452) * [@Tyriar (Daniel Imms)](https://github.com/Tyriar): Remove self from notify, classifier, events, etc. [PR #304498](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/304498) * [@xingsy97 (xingsy97)](https://github.com/xingsy97) * Keyboard layout - replace all dashes/dots in macOS layout labels [PR #303971](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/303971) * Editor - fix paste preference filter matching all providers [PR #304044](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/304044) * Settings editor - avoid repeated extension list refresh [PR #303957](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/303957) * settings: use local StopWatch to avoid timing corruption between concurrent searches [PR #304361](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/304361) * mergeEditor: optimize removeDiffs from O(K*N) to single-pass O(N) [PR #304404](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/304404) * timeline: fix memory leak when toggling pane visibility [PR #304668](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/304668) * notebook: fix unused cell lookup and broken selection deduplication [PR #305105](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/305105) * Chat - remove deprecated prompt attribute spelling [PR #301976](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/301976) * [@yogeshwaran-c (Yogeshwaran C)](https://github.com/yogeshwaran-c) * fix: prevent terminal panel from overwriting terminalEditorActive context key [PR #304802](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/304802) * fix: modernize HTML sample snippet [PR #304818](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/304818) * fix: make testing icon colors inherit from list error/warning foreground [PR #304959](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/304959) * fix: enable zoom for SVGs without explicit width/height dimensions [PR #304973](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/304973) * fix: persist test coverage sort order across sessions [PR #304979](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/304979) * fix: send user preferences to TS server even without visible editor [PR #304987](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/304987) Contributions to `vscode-pull-request-github`: * [@Daniel-Aaron-Bloom](https://github.com/Daniel-Aaron-Bloom): Link to local file for permalinks in webview [PR #8583](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-pull-request-github/pull/8583) Contributions to `monaco-editor`: * [@pgoslatara (Pádraic Slattery)](https://github.com/pgoslatara): chore: Update outdated GitHub Actions versions [PR #5214](https://github.com/microsoft/monaco-editor/pull/5214) --- We really appreciate people trying our new features as soon as they are ready, so check back here often and learn what's new. >If you'd like to read release notes for previous VS Code versions, go to [Updates](https://code.visualstudio.com/updates) on [code.visualstudio.com](https://code.visualstudio.com).
